import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Editable list: one entry per strategy (family + parameters).
# normal      -> params: mu, sigma
# student_t   -> params: nu, mu, sigma
# skew_normal -> params: xi, omega, alpha
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
STRATEGIES = [
    {'title': 'A1 analytics-game_mgmt: Model-faithful 4th-down and 2-pt aggression',
     'family': 'skew_normal',
     'params': {'xi': 0.30, 'omega': 0.40, 'alpha': 2.0},
     'most_plausible': 0.50},
    {'title': 'A2 analytics-offense: Early-down dropback bias with heavy play-action',
     'family': 'normal',
     'params': {'mu': 0.45, 'sigma': 0.434},
     'most_plausible': 0.45},
    {'title': 'A3 analytics-defense: Two-high light-box coverage-first defense',
     'family': 'normal',
     'params': {'mu': 0.30, 'sigma': 0.383},
     'most_plausible': 0.30},
    {'title': 'I1 intuition-game_mgmt: Proactive timeout spending',
     'family': 'skew_normal',
     'params': {'xi': 0.305, 'omega': 0.382, 'alpha': -2.0},
     'most_plausible': 0.10},
    {'title': 'I2 intuition-offense: Standing chaos package',
     'family': 'student_t',
     'params': {'nu': 4.0, 'mu': 0.20, 'sigma': 0.396},
     'most_plausible': 0.20},
    {'title': 'I3 intuition-defense: Late-rotation disguise with cross-trained DBs',
     'family': 'student_t',
     'params': {'nu': 7.0, 'mu': 0.25, 'sigma': 0.423},
     'most_plausible': 0.25},
]

def build_dist(spec):
    fam = spec['family']
    p = spec['params']
    if fam == 'normal':
        return stats.norm(loc=p['mu'], scale=p['sigma'])
    if fam == 'student_t':
        return stats.t(df=p['nu'], loc=p['mu'], scale=p['sigma'])
    if fam == 'skew_normal':
        return stats.skewnorm(a=p['alpha'], loc=p['xi'], scale=p['omega'])
    raise ValueError('unknown family: ' + fam)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(17, 9))
axes = axes.ravel()

for ax, spec in zip(axes, STRATEGIES):
    dist = build_dist(spec)
    lo = float(dist.ppf(0.025))
    hi = float(dist.ppf(0.975))
    span = hi - lo
    xs = np.linspace(lo - 0.35 * span, hi + 0.35 * span, 800)
    ys = dist.pdf(xs)
    ax.plot(xs, ys, color='black', lw=1.5)
    mask = (xs >= lo) & (xs <= hi)
    ax.fill_between(xs[mask], 0.0, ys[mask], color='steelblue', alpha=0.35,
                    label='central 95% via ppf: [' + format(lo, '.2f') + ', ' + format(hi, '.2f') + ']')
    mp = spec['most_plausible']
    ax.axvline(mp, color='crimson', linestyle='--', lw=1.5,
               label='most plausible = ' + format(mp, '.2f'))
    ax.axvline(0.0, color='gray', lw=0.8, linestyle=':')
    ax.set_title(spec['title'], fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel('Change in own scoring margin (points)')
    ax.set_ylabel('density')
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='upper right')
    print(spec['title'])
    print('  family: ' + spec['family'] + ' | params: ' + str(spec['params']))
    print('  ppf-based 95% interval: [' + format(lo, '.3f') + ', ' + format(hi, '.3f') + ']')

fig.suptitle('Subjective priors: per-game scoring-margin effect of each strategy', fontsize=13)
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.95))
